note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 48(1)(a), GUY 9,  Schedule 1, 2; A06b Const 48(1)(a), GUY 9,  Schedule 1, 2; L05 Const 46(1)): ordinary naturalisation after 6 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Guyana, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Guyana for 12 months immediately prior to the application, and 5 out of 7 years prior to the 12-month period. Intent to reside in the country. ... n.a. ... A person acquires citizenship of another country by a voluntary and official act otherwise than by marriage after May 25, 1966.
